_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: THE PERSISTENT MEMBER SHELL, THE SOCIAL COMMUNITY, GOAL SETUP, THE RESPONSIVE PUBLIC DISPLAY, KIOSK IDLE-FINISH AND THE WORDMARK GUARD, ON TOP OF EVERYTHING THE PREVIOUS PIN SERVED. Carried unchanged from c8f38e3: the five accepted member pages, Batch A identity and onboarding, the accepted invitation /join/[joinCode], kiosk confinement and /?view=communities. NEW IN THIS PIN (each accepted by the Director and independently verified, integrated on the app-shell branch by merge commit): the persistent member shell (PR #443 at fca3326, integrated as dd86721; true Expo Router Tabs with a persistent top bar, real tabs that reselect as a no-op, MOVE as a focus sheet over the mounted tab, /contribute, /goals/new, /start-community and /join as focused barless flows, Settings as a stack utility; the tab routes moved into app/(tabs)/) plus its one-line test guard (7f23eba4, integrated as f2f901a); the social community (PR #441 at bfc422a, integrated as 3e6a86b with the emulator-config mirror 1041a1f; presence as initials, a truthful member count, named-or-anonymous recent momentum, N people moved today on the goal's own timezone, Members as people, /settings with per-community Show my name / Show my contributions controls; community-visible by default to authenticated active members, never internet-public, never public-display, kiosk or station identity); /goals/new (PR #433 at e0546b3, integrated as 2fffcf3); the responsive public display (PR #435, product 1fd669f, integrated as ba774ef); kiosk idle-Finish on the closed, not-found and load-error states (PR #436 at 84acea5, integrated as d86620c); the Goal Setup wordmark guard (PR #446 at 1116695, integrated as 37367fd); and the @react-navigation/bottom-tabs dependency (9a65324). NOT A FRONTEND-ONLY PIN. THREE NEW FUNCTIONS: functions-westayfit exports 49 where c8f38e3 exported 46 — wsfSetCommunityVisibility, wsfCommunityMembers and wsfCommunityActivity, all member-only (request.auth required in code; not invoker: 'public'). They are listed in candidateAddedFunctions so the verifier accepts exactly them and nothing else; expectedPriorFunctions stays 46 because that is the measured BEFORE. TRANSPORT OF THE THREE IS MEASURED AFTER THE DEPLOY, NEVER ASSUMED: the deployer has historically been unable to set a new service's invoker policy, so the three may deploy SHUT; if so, the narrow per-service invokerIamDisabled correction is a separate reviewed operator action through the named operator (docs/wsf-staging/OPERATOR-HANDOFF-social-staging.md, Operation 2), followed by a schema-matched read-back where empty output proves neither OPEN nor SHUT. VERIFY=pass with the three SHUT is not a working feature. ONE NEW FIRESTORE INDEX: firestore.indexes.json declares the first wsf composite index (wsfContributions: communityGroupId ASC, createdAt DESC) that wsfCommunityActivity requires; THIS WORKFLOW NEVER DEPLOYS INDEXES, so the index must be created by the named operator on westayfit-staging only (SINGLE-INDEX-OPERATOR-PROCEDURE.md, never the shared catalog) and its READY receipt recorded BEFORE this pin is dispatched. HOSTING: firebase.westayfit.json adds the /community/*/members rewrite; the operational firebase.westayfit.staging.json now carries the same twelve rewrites in the same order (PR #449, merged), which the deploy job's hosting-route check (PR #450, under review) will enforce. firestore.rules is unchanged. DISPATCH PRECONDITIONS (Director 5798443901, owner 5797657663): this pin merged after independent review; the index READY receipt; a NAMED legitimate operator with the applicable access whose pre-deploy preflight succeeded, and an agreed post-deploy handoff. None of those is claimed by this file. AFTER DEPLOY: measure the three transports, correct only if SHUT, read back, then member / non-member / privacy smokes; the served claim only after the owner's seven conditions including the members deep link and /move/<goalId> direct-load rendering the right UI. HOLDS UNCHANGED: EMAIL DELIVERY BLOCKED AT RUNTIME; SIGNUP SMOKE INCOMPLETE — the observed sends fail during Admin Auth link generation before the provider, so a real signup cannot complete on this staging until the runtime permission is reconciled by the operator (separate track). KIOSK HOLD UNCHANGED: shared and unattended kiosk use remains HELD by the owner; kiosk confinement, idle-Finish and the shell's re-expression of the kiosk exclusion do not clear it. No rankings, no streaks, no health data, no photo collection, no coaching upsell, no forced sharing. No production change.

_twelveTransportNote: SUPERSEDED READING, CORRECTED HERE. An earlier version of this note said twelve services (wsfeventcontext, wsfjointurnline, wsfturnready, wsfmyturn, wsfcompletemyturn, wsfleaveturnline, wsfcreatecombinedgoal, wsfclosecombinedgoal, wsfrepaircombinedgoal, wsfapprovestation, wsfliststations, wsfrevokestation) remained invoker_iam_check_enabled, citing run 35450108207, and concluded the expo queue path was unusable. That is WRONG as of the later run 35474881609 (run 32, 2026-09-19T23:06:35Z), whose verify receipt reads every one of those twelve as invoker_iam_check_disabled, alongside PREEXISTING_TRANSPORT_VERIFIED=22/22, NEW_SERVICE_TRANSPORT=invoker_iam_check_disabled and VERIFY=pass. The transports are open. Read from that run's own log, not carried over from a review. WHAT RUN 32 ALSO EXERCISED, which is a separate and stronger fact than transport: eight of those twelve answered at the application level in its 24-PASS turn row, called with synthetic members' own Firebase ID tokens - wsfEventContext, wsfJoinTurnLine, wsfLeaveTurnLine, wsfMyTurn, wsfTurnReady, wsfCompleteMyTurn, wsfCreateCombinedGoal and wsfApproveStation. THE OTHER FOUR ARE TRANSPORT-OPEN BUT UNEXERCISED: wsfCloseCombinedGoal, wsfRepairCombinedGoal, wsfListStations and wsfRevokeStation are not called by hosted-package-e-smoke.mjs at all, so no hosted run has established how they answer. SCOPE, AND THE LINE THIS NOTE MUST NOT CROSS: service-level acceptance is not the browser/player journey. It does not establish QR to retained activity/auth to phone-or-queue choice to ready/start to shared player to review/receipt to cleared station. That gate remains pending until 6b257c3 is actually served and one hosted player run passes. Nothing in this pin changes any transport, IAM binding or function code.
